summary: AXIA Energia S.A. files Form 6-K announcing B3 approval to migrate to Novo Mercado, converting Class A1 and B1 preferred shares into common shares at a 1.1:1 ratio, with ADRs similarly converted. The migration simplifies the capital structure, enhances liquidity, and elevates corporate governance. The timeline starts June 5, 2026, with conversion, followed by ON share trading on June 8. Fractional shares will be auctioned. No price per share, premium, or advisor is stated; the event is a structural reorganization rather than a cash return, but falls under capital returns due to the conversion and simplification focus.
